values.note: 2026: every electric site $40 a night, up to 5 people ($2 a night each extra). Non-campers pay $20 to use the dump station and $10 for showers. Read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: http://www.coshoctonlakepark.com/campground/ ('CAMPGROUND FEES FOR 2026 Electric Sites – All $40.00'; 'Maximum of 5 people per permit allowed. (Including children) Additional persons will be charged $2.00 each per night.'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: http://www.coshoctonlakepark.com/campground/ ('Electric on each site is 30 AMP'; 'No direct water hook-up is permitted. Please turn off water hydrants after use.'; 'Gray water may only be disposed of at designated locations or at the dump station.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 69 back-in gravel electric sites; sites 1-60 are 42-46 ft deep, 62-69 48 ft. Electric boxes sit at varying distances: bring a long cord.

sites.source: http://www.coshoctonlakepark.com/campground/ ('Sites 1-60 are between 42-46 feet deep. Sites 62-69 are 48 feet deep'; 'All sites are back-ins.'; 'Electric boxes are varying distances from sites…please bring long cords') + campground-map.jpg (sites 1-69), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Restroom and shower building in the loop; water hydrants around the sites; firewood $7 a bundle at the office. Campers get one aquatic-center swim pass for every two nights paid.

facilities.source: http://www.coshoctonlakepark.com/campground/ ('Showers – Non-Registered Campers $10.00'; 'Dump Station Fee (Non-Registered Campers)'; 'Please turn off water hydrants after use.'; 'complementary swim pass (1 pass, good for one person, one-day, for every two nights paid)') + campground-map.jpg ('RESTROOMS & SHOWER FACILITY', hydrant symbols), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations by phone to the Park District office, weekdays 8-4, (740) 622-7528; 2027 reservations open January 4, 2027 (the first business day of each year, for that season only). First night's deposit within 7 days; no refunds. Check-in and check-out noon. Open until November, weather permitting.

booking.source: http://www.coshoctonlakepark.com/campground/ ('Reservations can be made by phoning the Park District Office weekdays from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM at 740-622-7528. 2027 reservations begin January 4, 2027. Campground will open until November- weather permitting.'; 'Maximum camper stay on one site is 14 nights.'; 'Check-in time is 12:00 noon and check-out time is 12:00 noon.'), read 2026-10-30

note: Coshocton Park District campground in Lake Park, by the Walhonding River on the north edge of Coshocton, beside ball diamonds and the park's aquatic center. No alcohol anywhere on Park District grounds. --Claude
